Ditwah Data Hub Project
Description: Converted unstructured PDF reports related to Cyclone Ditwah into analysis-ready datasets and developed an interactive disaster analytics platform to visualize and monitor the cyclone’s impacts in Sri Lanka.

Tech Stack: R, Quarto, ggplot2, Data Visualization, Geospatial Analytics

Forecasting Commodity Net Export Price Index (CNEPI)
Description: Developed an ARIMA model to forecast the Commodity Net Export Price Index (CNEPI)
Tech Stack: R, ARIMA, Forecast Package, Time Series Analysis

title: About
text:
I am a final year Statistics undergraduate in the Department of Statistics, University of Sri Jayewardenepura. I completed my primary and secondary education at Maliyadeva Balika Vidyalaya. Currently, I am conducting my final-year undergraduate research under the supervision of Prof. Sarath Banneheka.
I am passionate about data analysis, statistical modeling, and programming in R.
My interests include Advanced statistical Inference, Probability and Distribution Theory, Statistical Quality Control, Time Series Analysis, Data Visualization, and real-world problem solving using data.
I enjoy transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support decision-making.
